evals.prompt: Validate this: 'BTC bearish because weekend low volume. Probability 0.62. Invalidated if sentiment turns.'
evals.expected_output: FAIL: condition only, no lever; missing thesis magnitude and timeframe; vague invalidation.
expectations: Says the prediction uses a condition (weekend low volume) with no lever: no named actor, action or liquidity valve
Flags missing magnitude and timeframe in the thesis
Flags the invalidation ('sentiment turns') as unobservable
Flags the missing confidence label from the set confirmed/derived/estimated/rumored/inferred
Does not recommend logging it to the journal

evals.prompt: Validate: LEVER: Tether minted $500M USDT on 2026-03-29 (valve: crypto liquidity). CONDITION: BTC at support with low volume. THESIS: BTC +2-3% within 6h. INVALIDATION: no new mint confirmed within 24h. CONFIDENCE: estimated. PROBABILITY: 2.5
evals.expected_output: FAIL on probability out of [0,1] (and the invalidation overlaps the lever's occurrence); otherwise structure is fine.
expectations: Returns FAIL specifically because probability 2.5 is outside [0, 1]
Identifies lever (Tether, $500M mint, crypto liquidity valve) and condition (low volume at support) as distinct and valid
States that the prediction would pass if the probability were a valid value such as 0.25
Optionally notes the invalidation is about the lever's confirmation rather than a mutually exclusive observable market outcome

evals.prompt: Validate and, if it passes, log it: LEVER: Fed raised the discount rate 50bp on 2026-03-30 (credit valve). CONDITION: financial conditions index +1.5 sd. THESIS: XLF -3% to -5% within 72h. INVALIDATION: Fed signals a cut within 24h OR XLF closes above $50. CONFIDENCE: confirmed. PROBABILITY: 0.75
evals.expected_output: PASS on structure; then the journal logging path must be checked (validate_prediction module path) and journal immutability respected.
expectations: Returns PASS with per-section reasoning (lever, condition, thesis, invalidation, confidence, probability)
Checks the cited source is within its evaluation window if an alt-data source is cited (none here; Fed release is primary)
Before logging, verifies the validator referenced in the skill (validation/prediction_validator.py) actually exists in the repo and reports if it does not
Treats the journal as append-only/immutable and does not edit or delete existing journal entries
